title: Avoid automatic aphorism endings
rule: Do not end every paragraph by restating its point as an aphorism.
example: End the paragraph after the result and its needed limitation.
counterexample: Append “Ultimately, progress is the art of possibility” after every paragraph.
rationale: A repeated closing flourish adds little information.
evidence: Migrated from existing repository guidance: `deslopify/ne-fac/_template/general.md`. Examples are illustrative.
